title: Detailed bathtub
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="waterGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5BC8F5"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2E9BD6"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tubGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F0F4FF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#B8C6E0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="rimGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#D0D8EE"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Floor shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="38" ry="5" fill="#3A3F6E" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Bathtub body -->
  <path d="M12,48 Q12,85 22,86 L78,86 Q88,85 88,48 Z" fill="url(#tubGrad)"/>
  <!-- Tub highlight -->
  <path d="M18,52 Q18,80 25,82 L75,82 Q82,80 82,52 Z" fill="#DCE4F5" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Bathtub rim -->
  <rect x="8" y="42" width="84" height="10" rx="5" fill="url(#rimGrad)"/>
  <rect x="8" y="42" width="84" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Water inside tub -->
  <rect x="16" y="50" width="68" height="30" rx="3" fill="url(#waterGrad)"/>
  <!-- Water bubbles -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="60" r="3" fill="#A8E6FF" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="65" r="2.5" fill="#A8E6FF" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="58" r="3.5" fill="#A8E6FF" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="68" r="2" fill="#A8E6FF" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="72" r="2.5" fill="#A8E6FF" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="74" r="2" fill="#A8E6FF" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="70" r="2" fill="#A8E6FF" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Bubbles on top of water -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="50" r="4" fill="#E8F8FF" opacity="0.85"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="49" r="3" fill="#E8F8FF" opacity="0.85"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="50" r="4.5" fill="#E8F8FF" opacity="0.85"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="49" r="3.5" fill="#E8F8FF" opacity="0.85"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="50" r="3" fill="#E8F8FF" opacity="0.85"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="48" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="47" r="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- Faucet base -->
  <rect x="72" y="32" width="10" height="12" rx="2" fill="#C0C8D8"/>
  <!-- Faucet spout -->
  <path d="M77,32 L77,20 Q77,14 71,14 L62,14 Q58,14 58,18 L58,22" fill="none" stroke="#C0C8D8" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Faucet spout highlight -->
  <path d="M77,32 L77,20 Q77,15 71,15 L63,15" fill="none" stroke="#E8ECF5" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Faucet handle base -->
  <rect x="74" y="28" width="6" height="4" rx="1" fill="#8890A8"/>
  <!-- Faucet handle left -->
  <rect x="70" y="27" width="5" height="6" rx="2" fill="#A0A8C0"/>
  <!-- Faucet handle right -->
  <rect x="79" y="27" width="5" height="6" rx="2" fill="#A0A8C0"/>

  <!-- Water drip from faucet -->
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="26" rx="2" ry="3" fill="#5BC8F5" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Tub feet left -->
  <path d="M18,86 Q16,92 20,93 Q24,93 24,89 L24,86 Z" fill="#8890A8"/>
  <path d="M18,86 Q16,91 20,92" fill="none" stroke="#A8B0C8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Tub feet right -->
  <path d="M76,86 Q74,92 78,93 Q82,93 82,89 L82,86 Z" fill="#8890A8"/>
  <path d="M76,86 Q74,91 78,92" fill="none" stroke="#A8B0C8" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Rubber duck -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="47" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="43" r="3" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="33.5" cy="42.5" r="1.2" fill="#FF9900"/>
  <circle cx="33" cy="42.5" r="0.6" fill="#333"/> <!-- eye -->
  <path d="M36,43 L38,44 L36,44.5 Z" fill="#FF6600"/> <!-- beak -->
</svg>
